mapper.insert: insert into orders(order_no, goods_id, num, user_id, status, time, address_id) values (#{orderNo}, #{goodsId}, #{num}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{time}, #{addressId})
mapper.update: update orders set order_no = #{orderNo}, goods_id = #{goodsId}, num = #{num}, user_id = #{userId}, status = #{status}, time = #{time}, address_id = #{addressId} where id = #{id}
